# SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — NOT the real CWN SRD.
#
# This file mimics the *text layout* of the Cities Without Number SRD §3.0.0
# equipment chapter so the CWN extraction tool can be exercised in unit tests without
# depending on the real, out-of-repo SRD PDF. The rows below are invented,
# schema-shaped stand-ins. Values are deliberately NOT the real SRD numbers — this is a
# parser fixture, not bound content.
#
# Per ADR-145 D4 the Without Number SRDs share most of one item schema, but CWN adds
# columns the WWN tool does not (story 114-12):
#
#   Armor : Name  AC  Soak  Cost  Enc        — CWN armor is dual-stat (ascending AC +
#                                               a Soak/mitigation value); a '-' Soak
#                                               cell is a verbatim "no soak".
#   Melee : Name  Damage  Shock  Trauma  Enc  Cost  Attribute
#                                             — the Trauma cell is "<die>/x<rating>/
#                                               T<target>" (e.g. 1d10/x2/T6), or "None"
#                                               for a weapon with no Trauma rating.
#
# CWN's net-new SECTION is **Cyberware**, whose defining mechanical extra is **System
# Strain** (the real §3.6.7 layout: Name Cost Location Concealment SystemStrain Effect).
# System Strain is a non-negative number raising the permanent-strain floor on install.
# It is often FRACTIONAL — CWN prices common chrome at 0.25/0.5 — so the first row below
# carries strain 0.25 to exercise the float path. The first arabic number in a cyberware
# row is the Cost, the second is the System Strain; Roman-numeral name grades are safe.

§3.0.0 Equipment

§3.0.1 Armor
Name                AC    Soak    Cost    Enc
Test Armor Weave    14    1       300     1
Test Combat Frame   17    3       4000    2

Test Shock Baton    1d6      1/AC13     None           1     100    Str

§3.0.5 Cyberware
